viewport_notes: the subscription PDP / buy box (one-time vs subscribe-and-save) + the customer manage-subscription view. Judge clarity + honesty of the offer, and that managing it isn't a trap.

checks.rule: no missing image, no Liquid/render errors, no Lorem/[CLAIM] text, no broken price
one-time vs subscribe choice is visible + unambiguous; the selected plan is obvious and the price reflects it
the subscribe price/discount shown is the REAL app-driven delta — not a fabricated 'save X%' with no actual reduction (honesty)
delivery frequency + billing cadence + cancel/skip terms are stated near the selector — no hidden commitment
Add-to-Cart / Subscribe binds the SELECTED plan (not the wrong selling_plan) — the cart shows the chosen cadence
(manage view) skip / swap / pause / cancel are reachable and not dark-patterned (no buried cancel)
no overflow/overlap; the plan selector + terms don't collide; typography cascade intact
the subscription block is designed + on-brand, not the raw subscription-app default widget

mobile_overlay.rule: plan radios + frequency selector + subscribe button are ≥44px and not crammed
the subscribe/ATC stays reachable on mobile as the shopper scrolls the terms
